note.zh-TW: 直譯自日文的投資その他の資産；台灣報表拆成採用權益法之投資、其他非流動金融資產、其他非流動資產等，網站維持課程名稱為主要顯示並加現行對照（設計說明見 T15）。
note.en: A direct translation of the Japanese balance sheet category. Taiwanese statements split it into investments under the equity method, other non-current financial assets and other non-current assets; the site keeps the course name as the main display with the current captions alongside (see the design note T15).

definition.zh-TW: 模板裡放長期投資與其他非流動資產的一列。它包含哪些項目教材沒有說明，本課的故事也沒有用到。
definition.en: A template line for long-term investments and other non-current assets. The course does not say what it contains, and the story does not use it.
